settings.remote.setupCommands:
# 1) Run in the Mac terminal: copy the setup script to the remote host
scp '{scriptPath}' {target}:~/workisland-remote.cjs

# 2) Run on the remote host (or hand the whole block to its AI assistant)
node ~/workisland-remote.cjs pair {token}
node ~/workisland-remote.cjs install-hooks

# 3) Run a real task afterwards — the host shows up on the Island
